weapon_system.meter_rules: Each red capsule moves the lit cell one step, 1 to 6 and round again, pays 500 points and plays 0x11 (p01:$7571 recoge_la_mejora_del_medidor). The second button (M or N keys, row 4 bits 2-3, or joystick button 2; p00:$5785) takes the lit cell if not already owned, plays 0x14 and puts the meter back to zero (p03:$A068). Owned cells are drawn lit (p03:$A022).

weapons.level_up: second MISSILE: E20F = 2 (three missile slots at E2C0, p03:$A1DA)
up to two, following a 16-entry position queue (p02:$9BFB monta_una_opcion)

special_capsules.rule: left by a marked enemy with mark 1, by the last enemy of a six-group, or by a cannon with mark 1 (p00:$5E65)
mark 2 (1 enemy in 16, p03:$A5C7) or the last enemy of every 8th six-group: destroys everything on screen, plays 0x12 (p01:$758E recoge_la_bomba)
bonus stages only: one more ship, 0x11 (p01:$74BC)
bonus stages only: pays the chain 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 (x100 points) for consecutive capsules, counter E128 up to 7 (p01:$7553); type 0x18 can be collected 8 times
bonus stages only: invisible; touching it turns it into a 1UP or a bonus capsule (p01:$74E8)

weapon_system.shield_rules: Shield on (E200 = 3, E201 = 10). A sprite enemy or shot that touches the shield box (x+12) costs one point and is destroyed (p01:$73F4); below 2 points the shield is weak (E200 = 2), at 0 it is gone (p01:$740C). Anything drawn with characters that touches it kills the ship (p01:$73D7).
weapon_system.option_rules: max 2 (p03:$A14A); each follows the ship along a 16-entry position queue (p02:$9BFB); options collect items too (p01:$74B5 reparte_por_el_tipo_tocado)

player.lives_source: p00:$5565 copies 03 01 to E060/E061 (BCD lives, stage 1)
player.extends: one ship every 100,000 points, starting at 100,000 (E067 = 0x0010 compared with the top four BCD digits, +0x0010 each time; score digits x100 on screen), up to 99 ships (p00:$55DE, p00:$561C); 1UP items in the bonus stages
player.speed_levels: E202 starts at 0 (ship card p00:$4193); each SPEED UP adds 1; the HYPER cheat sets 1; DOWN resets to 0; the meter cell counts as owned at 8
player.death: Touching terrain, an enemy or a shot without a shield (p01:$7338, $7354, $7485 -> p01:$75F0 la_nave_ha_muerto, jingle 0x47). The ship card is reset to p00:$4193 at the next life (speed, weapons, options and shield lost). The stage restarts at its checkpoint if the distance reached was past it, else at 0x20 (p00:$41C3, table p00:$4212: stage 1 0xF8, stage 2 0x100, stage 3 0xF2, stage 4 0x100, stage 5 0x100, stage 6 0x100, stage 7 0xF8, stage 8 0x100, stage 9 0x100, stage 10 0x100, stage 11 0x100).
player.continue: At game over the screen offers CONTINUE F5 (p00:$54D9); F5 (row 7 bit 1) clears the score and gives 3 ships again on the same stage (p00:$549A estado_7). No limit on continues.
player.two_players: Alternating: when a player loses a ship and the other still has ships, the 0x30 bytes of player state at E060 (lives, stage, distance, loop, power-up counters) are swapped with E090 and bit 7 of E002 changes turn (p00:$547B cambia_de_jugador). Scores are separate (E05B / E057); the high score E053 is shared.

scoring.units: score kept as 6 BCD digits (E05C..E05E player 1), shown with two fixed zeros: 1 unit = 100 points (p00:$55B4)
scoring.big_pieces: 1000 for hatches, heads, stage-5 pieces and walls, boss pieces (p01:$77AB, $7A6D, $7ADE, $7B16, $7C1C)
scoring.big_core: 500 every third core hit (p01:$7883), 10000 when destroyed (p01:$7D4D)
scoring.ending: 500 at the end of the ending (p00:$4C79 explosion_paso_8)

difficulty.stage_start: E111 = 4 x loop (E06A) + stage - 1, capped at 15, for stages 1-8; in the bonus stages E111 = E066, the number of stages ended normally (p00:$41A3)
difficulty.during_play: each MISSILE, OPTION or shield taken adds 1 (p01:$70CA sube_la_dificultad), each stage end adds 1 (p01:$6FD0)
what_it_changes: waits between groups: 0x70 - 2*E111 (type 03 pairs, type 04 rows), 0x70 - 4*E111 (type 05), 0x60 - 4*E111 (type 06), 0x50 - 4*E111 (mixed) (p03:$A49C, $A618, $A653, $A684)
cannon fire wait from the ramp p02:$91C5 (p02:$9181)
rock rain 0x14 - E111 frames, vent rocks 0x5C - 4*E111, spiral flock 0x1F - E111, triangle flock 0x28 - 2*E111, both flocks last (E111 + 0x14) x 0x1E frames
difficulty.loops: After stage 8 and the ending the game goes back to stage 1 with E06A + 1 (p01:$6FF8). What changes by loop: loop 1 (E06A = 0) the base difficulty is stage - 1; loop 2 +4; loop 3 +8; loop 4 and later capped at 15. From loop 2: stage-3 kind-6 chaser at distance 0x60 (p01:$6DE1), the Big Core answers player shots with bursts of six aimed shots (p01:$7D6A), type-09 flocks move 3 px instead of 2 (p03:$ADB9), type 1B two speed steps faster (p03:$B8ED), type 1D fires on its own timer (p03:$BA78), type 1E fires when the player has two options (p03:$BCC9), type-08 rocks fire while the ship has the full shield. From loop 3: type 09 fires (p03:$ADEE) and type-08 rocks always fire (p03:$ACEA). The ending text cycles every 5 loops with E070: GOOD, NICE, FINE, GREAT, then the fifth (Japanese text on Japanese machines, CONGRATULATIONS elsewhere) (p00:$4C31).

per_loop.changes: type-08 rocks and type 09 do not fire; Big Core fires only its own shots

stage-3 kind-6 chaser at 0x60; Big Core answers player shots with six aimed shots; type 09 faster; type 1B faster; type 1D fires on its timer; type 1E fires with two options; type-08 rocks fire while the ship has the full shield
as loop 2, plus type 09 fires and type-08 rocks always fire

per_loop.ending_text: Japanese text on Japanese machines, CONGRATULATIONS elsewhere (E070 4, BIOS 0x002B)
per_loop.changes: as loop 3; after this ending E070 starts again at GOOD while E06A keeps counting (to 255)

difficulty.rank: Power raises E111 (missile, options, shield) and some enemies fire more with the player's power: type 1D every 0x40 frames with one option, every 0x20 with two (p03:$BA6B); type 1E only with two options from loop 2 (p03:$BCCE)

meter_rules: A red capsule (type 0x29, from a capsule carrier, a whole wave, a turret flag or a block) lights the next box, wrapping to box 1 (p02:$8F7D recoge_capsula, 500 points)
The second button (M / button 2, 0xE1C8 bit 5) takes the lit box if it is not spent (0xFF) (p01:$7D4F); sound 0x06
Shot types are exclusive: DOUBLE (and REFLEX RING / FIRE BLASTER), UP LASER, DOWN LASER, LASER (and EXTEND), BACK BEAM replace each other and re-enable the boxes of the others (p01:$7FB3-$8048)
MISSILE and DOWN LASER exclude each other (p01:$7E33, p01:$7F16)
Taking MISSILE, DOUBLE, UP, DOWN or OPTION raises the level by 0x80 (half a level), LASER by 0x40, FORCE FIELD by 0x100 (p01:$7FA4 sube_el_nivel)
The 25 labels are pictures (p14:$9BD3): 1 BACK UP (Galious), 2 SPEED ... 20 FORCE FIELD, 21 ENABLE (spent), 22-25 R.DRILL, VECTOR, E.SLOW, D.VARRIOR countdowns

weapons.level_up: LASER #2, then EXTEND LASER (n2.weapon.extend_laser, needs 5 captured)
max 2, follow the ship trail 8 and 16 positions behind (p03:$AAEC)

weapon_system.captured_weapons: Interior prize (p02:$9218): fight under 300 frames = 2, under 900 = 1, else NOTHING; at most 1 with 6 captured, none with 7. Order: UP LASER, DOWN LASER, NAPALM MISSILE, REFLEX RING, EXTEND LASER, BACK BEAM, FIRE BLASTER (0xE20F, max 7, p02:$80C6). Each capture rebuilds the meter (p02:$80D8, pairs p02:$8146) and re-enables a box (3: MISSILE, 4: DOUBLE, 5: LASER... p02:$8112). Captured weapons are kept for the rest of the game (lives and continues).

player.death: on contact with solid map characters, enemies or bullets (p02:$8E7C nave_cae, sound 0x3D): the ship explodes; with lives left the next life (state 4) starts at the stage checkpoint if passed, else column 0x020; after a beaten boss (0xE22C) at the next stage; in an interior at the stage stored in 0xE22A (p01:$60FD). The ship, its weapons, options, shield and the meter are reset (p01:$6888, p00:$5366); captured weapons stay; the level is reset to stages played / 2 (p01:$68AA).
player.continue: GAME OVER screen: F5 while the game-over music plays (0xE20C) continues on the same stage with score 0 and 3 lives (p00:$5851)

player.galious_equipment: with Maze of Galious in the other slot the equipment is saved on death (0xE210) and box 1 shows BACK UP to restore it (p02:$8E7C, p01:$7DD9)

difficulty.loops: One loop = stages 1-7 forward, interlude, 6-1 back (0xE20A odd), stage 0, ending. With EXTEND F5 the game goes on from stage 1 with 0xE20A even again (p01:$7C59); the level keeps growing.
difficulty.rank: Level 0xE228 (0-15): at each life = stages played (0xE206) / 2, capped 15 (p01:$68AA); +1 every two stages (each stage change adds 0x80, p01:$7C4B) and half a level per power-up taken (p01:$7FA4), max 15. The level shortens generator intervals (p01:$6FEA, $7024, $70A4, $70D3, $71A7), changes enemy speeds and fire (p02:$9393, $99F3, $9BB1, $9C95, $9EB0, p03:$A460, $B642, $BB19, $BC89), adds aiming error from level 7 (p02:$9401), enables the second filler generator from level 10 (p01:$6DF1) and boss fire rates (p11:$AA5D, $AAE2, $ABF4). The demo plays at level 0.
difficulty.return_trip: With 0xE20A odd: return-only objects (p02:$87C1), generator 5 (p01:$71EA), more enemy shots (p03:$A0A9, $A1EB, $A662), bosses fire more (p11:$AA3B, $AA7C), boss 4 uses beam 0x3A (p11:$AE0D), longer stage-5 event (900 frames, p03:$A040), class 1 gets 6 waits (p03:$B4C1).

special_stage_rules: Boss interiors (map_08): entered by flying into the boss mouth within 300 frames after the core is destroyed (p11:$A93F, p02:$92A4; not after boss 3); music 0x35; enemies from the stage-8 lists; a core of 24 hits at column 0x7F; reaching its X starts the 13-step ending with YOU CAPTURED and the prize (p01:$74A2); then the stage stored in 0xE22A.

Secret stages 9-11: only turrets, blocks with items/hidden items, falling pieces and breakable 0xA0 blocks (p01:$6D54 skips enemy lists, waves and fillers); entered at 1 column per frame; return to the stage that was due (0xE22A).
Stage 0 (final fortress): only on the return trip after stage 1; the final core ends the loop.
Stage 6: no boss, the rock-thrower event closes it; stage 7: no interior, its boss starts the return trip.
There are no vertical stages and no bonus stages other than the secret stages.

Pause: F1 (state 9, sound 0xF3/0xF2); with Q*bert in the other slot the keyboard keywords
GAME OVER: CONTINUE F5, HI SCORE and a 4-digit code
Ending: THE END, - EXTEND F5 -, PUSH SPACE KEY, LET'S START (next loop) or SEE YOU NEXT....

weapon_system.items_note: floating items come from the per-stage lists p12:$A181 (not from enemies); one at a time, not while a clock runs; items 5-7 only with two players (p01:$7C36); picked up within 8x11 px: 30 points, sound 0x52
weapon_system.shield_rules: F.FIELD (box 7): state 2, 10 hits (IY+22, p02:$960B); the ship drawing switches to the shield postures; colour 7 blink at the last hit; joined ships share the sum of both shields (p02:$9889-9899)
weapon_system.option_rules: up to 4 options (3 in all with two players), each following the ship's past positions (p03:$A668, 0xE400); O.HOLD (IY+34) and O.CHAIN (clock mode 6, p03:$A5EE -> p03:$A711) change how they follow
weapon_system.death: a new ship has state 1, NORMAL, no panel weapon, no bombs, no options, speed 0; the gauge: cursor back to box 1 if one was selected, box 2 full (0xFF), the others empty (p02:$87CC-8812, p00:$5D34-5D51)

player.lives_source: p00:$58BE initial record (3 lives, stage 1, scroll 0x20); continue gives 3 again (p00:$54D1)
player.extends: every 100,000 displayed points (score BCD bytes 0xE27B-0xE27E, display x100; next threshold IY+6..8 starts at 0x10 and grows by 0x10, p00:$5970-5999), and at every 15 bonus capsules once the bonus level is 7; max 99 lives
speed_levels: 1-7 by box 1: step = table p09:$A2F5 x (level + 3) (p02:$8447-8489)
player.death: terrain, enemies, enemy shots, boss parts; the ship explodes (state 0xFF, 4 frames x 4 ticks), lives - 1 when the stage restarts (state 4, p00:$53DD); the stage restarts from the checkpoint scroll p02:$88E8[stage] if passed, else from 0x20; all power-ups lost (see weapon_system.death)
player.continue: GAME OVER screen: F5 within 480 frames (0xE649, p00:$5519/p00:$55EA) continues with 3 lives and the score reset (p00:$553D) from the same stage

two_players.modes: title menu (cursor keys change 0xE227, p00:$5815): 1PLAYER (0), EXCHANGE (1: alternating, records swapped by p00:$549E when one dies), DUALPLAY (2: simultaneous, player 2 on joystick port 2)
two_players.selection: with 1PLAYER or EXCHANGE, F5 during the pause opens SELECTION (p12:$B877): YES gives player 2 three lives and the simultaneous game (0xE227 = 2)
two_players.joining: simultaneous game only: item 5 starts clock mode 5; while it runs, if both ships are in state 1/2 and within 8x16 px (16x8 in vertical stages) they join (p02:$9837-98F0): states 3 (drawn, 4 sprites, PILOT window piece 0x14) and 4 (not drawn, Co.PILOT 0x15) chosen by IY+1D, shields added, clock mode 7 for 0x30 s; joined ships unlock TWIN/TRIPLE/ARMING; capsules alternate between the two records (p02:$975A, p02:$97CC)
two_players.shared: options (3 in all), the floating item, the clock; separate scores, lives, gauges; enemy shots aim at both alternately (p01:$74B4)

scoring.display: score shown x100 (two fixed zeros): BCD 0x0001 = 100 points

difficulty.rank: 0xE64F (0-15): set at each stage start to 0xE304 / 2 (0xE304 = stages started, max 15, p02:$8703 / p02:$885B), 0 in the demo; raised by power-up activations (p02:$8AA8, +0.5 or +1); it shortens the wave delays (2 x rank), the enemy fire delay (p02:$818E / $819E[rank], minus 4 when player 1 has exactly 2 lives, minus 0xE304 / 4, at least 12; rank capped at 2 for this table while 0xE304 = 1, p02:$812C-8175) and adds the low-nibble waves of p14:$8550 at rank >= 10
difficulty.planet_rank: each middle planet gets a number (0xE233-0xE235): a random order of p10:$9A14 at the first choice, all three + 1 at each later choice; the chosen one goes to 0xE35F: with 0xE35F >= 4 every explosion 0x26 fires a shot at the player (p02:$81FE)
difficulty.loops: after an ending, EXTEND PLAY? Y (row 5 bit 6) starts stage 1 again (p00:$5755-5792): lives, score, weapons and options are kept; p00:$576D clears only IY+0A (0xE30A, the Crystal Breeze: it must be found again) and IY+60..67 (0xE360-0xE367, the planets-played flags and 0xE35E... of each player); 0xE304 keeps counting, so the rank keeps rising (emulator run mLoop: stage 1 restarted with 0xE304 = 7, rank 3, 5 lives, weapons kept); N (row 4 bit 3) or time out: SO LONG!, game over (p00:$5793)
difficulty.second_round_flag: 0xE305 is read as a second-round flag (piece list entries with bit 7 p01:$77DA, p03:$BD46 1200 instead of 900 ticks, boss 1 p11:$BE7D/BE8D) but no code writes it except the demo clear (p03:$BF66) and the initial record (0): those variants never happen

special_stage_rules: vertical stages (2, 3, 6; p02:$8921 / mask 0x26 p00:$4835, 0xE620 = 1): the map scrolls DOWNWARD - new rows of 8 blocks enter at the top (p00:$4A45 / p00:$4A8C, 21 visible rows) at the same speed; the ship uses the vertical drawings (posture tables p09:$A184 / $A19F, it points up) and leans with LEFT/RIGHT (joystick bits 2-3, p02:$82A5) instead of UP/DOWN; movement keys are unchanged (8 directions, p09:$A2F5); shots, lasers and missiles go up (vertical shot records p03:$AC49, p03:$ABB1, char lines turned, missile movers by 0xE620); the common sprite streams are the rotated ones (p09:$A009/$A0F3/$A122) and the char lists p07:$6C95 + p00:$4876; enemies, pieces, items and hidden items enter at the top with the coordinate as x (x/y swapped: p01:$70E0, p01:$7801, p01:$7C27, p12:$A6B3); enemy fire delay table p02:$819E; ship x clamped to 0x00-0xF0 (p02:$8415)

detours (stages 1, 4: shafts down; stage 6: sideways): the main scroll parks at a stop and 0xE612 counts through a separate detour map in bank 14 (p00:$4BE6) with its own spawn lists (p14:$85DF, p14:$9213); the scroll resumes when the counter reaches its target
boss fights: the scroll is stopped; the boss appears when no enemy is left (p11:$B523); waves and appearance lists stop; animated chars pause
stage 4 dark section: see the events of sal.map_04
stage 7: graphics partly from the Nemesis 2 cartridge, turrets from its events; two fixed cores in the scenery (0xE6C8) instead of a boss; no generic waves (p01:$6F33)
attract_and_menus: power on: Konami logo (state 0), title with PLAY SELECT 1PLAYER / EXCHANGE / DUALPLAY (state 1); idle: presentation and story (state 2, steps p10:$81ED), demo of stage 1 with two ships (p03:$BF4E / p03:$BF85, seen in run S1; rank 0 because 0xE202 bit 6 is clear, p00:$5B16); any key returns to the title
game start: take-off cut-scene (state 3, p10:$8848), OPERATION ONE card
pause: F1 in play (state 9); F1 again resumes; F5 in the pause opens SELECTION (one player / EXCHANGE)

between stages (state 8): stage cards, ASSESS ARMS... window and radar planet choice with a TIME counter starting at 3000 (p10:$99E1), cursor keys move (sound 0x45), the button chooses; at 0 the planet under the cursor is taken (p10:$9A43)
hidden-item results (state 12), endings and THE END / EXTEND PLAY? Y/N (state 10), GAME OVER / CONTINUE F5 (state 7)
language: Japanese or English texts by BIOS byte 0x002B (p10:$944C)

weapon_system.meter_rules: Each power capsule (0x3E or 0x47) moves the mark 0xE430 one slot, 1..8 and round again (p01:6A01), 500 points, sound 0x1A. Button 2 (M/N or joystick 2, 0xE308 bit 5) buys the marked slot unless its level has bit 7 (full) (p04:92D8); the mark goes back to 0, sound 0x1C. The cap of each slot is p04:94D0[8 x 0xE36F + slot] (p04:94B7). Buying raises the difficulty value 0xE388 by the rank column (halved with GOOD, doubled with HARD, p00:5692).

weapon_system.capsule_rule: An enemy created with C != 0 is drawn in colour 8 (p01:7744) and, when shot down, its explosion 0x3D carries C (p01:65A5) and turns into the capsule 0x3D + C (0x3E red, 0x3F blue) or 0x47 when the explosion has B != 0 (p02:9029); C = 0 for wave members, whose reward goes to the last one shot (p01:65A5).
weapon_system.shield_rules: Chosen before the game (0xE37F): SHIELD (front, ship state 2, 10 hits) or FORCE FIELD (ship state 3, 5 hits); EXPAND doubles the hits (p04:948D-94AA). Each hit takes one (0xE601); the sprites change with the hits left (p00:5019, n3.player.front_shield / force_field).
weapon_system.option_rules: Chosen before the game (0xE37E): SHADOW (0, follow the ship trail), FIXED (1) or ROLLING (2) (p04:85C9); max 2 options (slot 7); lost when the ship dies (p01:694F).

player.lives_start: 3 (p00:48CD), one taken when each life starts (p00:445F): 2 in reserve on the HUD
player.extends: every 100,000 points: score bytes 0xE357-0xE359 compared byte by byte with the next threshold 0xE367-0xE369 (BCD, starts 0x000010 = 100,000; +0x10 = +100,000 each time) (p00:492F); max 99 lives
speed_levels: level 0: 2.0 px per game frame per axis
level 1: 2.5 px per game frame per axis
level 2: 3.0 px per game frame per axis
level 3: 3.5 px per game frame per axis
level 4: 4.0 px per game frame per axis
level 5: 4.5 px per game frame per axis
level 6: 5.0 px per game frame per axis
level 7: 5.5 px per game frame per axis
player.death: the ship explodes (p04:843D); the stage is set up again (state 4, p00:5C0E clears 0xE400-0xEFFF): speed, weapons, options, shield and bar levels are lost; if a slot was marked, the mark restarts on slot 1 (0xE36D, p04:953D); restart scroll = the stage checkpoint (p19:A974) if it was passed, else 0x20; stage 4 restarts at its current boss (0xE37C). Secret-weapon level, maps and entrance flags stay.
player.two_players: alternating: 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS on the title (0xE302 bit 5); each player chooses a ship (state 3 step 7) and has his own 0x50-byte record 0xE360-0xE3AF (lives, stage, scroll, loop, secret level, choices, entrance flags, maps, passwords, difficulty) swapped with 0xE3B0 on each death when the other player has lives left (p00:44D4, p00:44E9); scores 0xE356 / 0xE35B; one high score; PLAYER 1 / 2 shown at each life start (p00:4483)
player.continue: GAME OVER and CONTINUE F5 for 0x1D8 game frames (p00:4505): with F5, 0xE355-0xE357 are zeroed (the score below 1,000,000 points; the higher bytes 0xE358-0xE359 stay, p00:453C), lives = 3 and the same stage restarts at its checkpoint rule (state 4); the secret-weapon level, maps, flags and loop are kept. With two players the game goes on with the other one if he has lives (p00:4553)

scoring.units: the score is BCD 0xE356-0xE359 shown with two fixed zeros (p00:49EB): 1 unit = 100 points
scoring.piece: 1,000 per piece destroyed (p01:66F5; piece 0x0A gives nothing)
scoring.boss: 10,000 per boss (p01:6BCD); boss 0x0E 10,000 per part, 3 parts (p05:BC40)

difficulty.value: 0xE388-0xE389 (16 bits); 0xE389 = level 0-0x0F read by the enemies (fire rate, speed, generator intervals)
difficulty.at_stage_start: after a death or at a new game: 0xE389 = min(15, 4 x loop 0xE36A + stage - 1), halved with GOOD (p00:5CC8); 0 in the demo (p00:5C3C)
difficulty.rises: +0x80 per stage cleared (p00:5619); + per purchase (meter rank column); x2 with HARD, /2 with GOOD; cap 0x0F00 (0x0C00 with GOOD) (p00:5692)
difficulty.loops: EXTEND PLAY (F5 after the ending) adds 1 to 0xE36A and clears the entrance flags 0xE38C-0xE397 (maps, shield, ESP, weapon entrances), then stage 1 straight in state 5 (p00:46E5-471A): lives, weapons, the secret-weapon level 0xE36F and the current difficulty carry over (checked: captures/stages/extendplay, loop 1, 0xE389 still 0x0A); the new loop counts at the next stage start after a death (4 x loop + stage - 1)
rank_uses: generators: 0x70 - 4 x level frames (enemy 0x0A), 0x90 - 4 x level (0x21), 0x30 - level (trios of 0x06), 2nd nibble at level >= 0x0A, enemy 2 every 4 frames at >= 0x0A

turret fire interval p02:9120: table p02:9179 by level (level capped at 2 while 0xE366, the stages-cleared counter, is 1), doubled every 4th shot, -4 when the ship has the SHIELD (state 2), minus 0xE366 / 4, min 12
enemy speeds p01:7844 and many routines (p02:8562, p02:94E4, p02:9659, p02:9911, p03:A07F, p03:A0D1, p04:9EF6...)
difficulty.demo: the attract demo of stages 1-3 plays with difficulty 0 and an invincible ship (two nops at p01:693D)

special_stage_rules: no vertical stages; every stage scrolls horizontally except stage 4 (no map)
stage 3: currents (p04:8237), whirlpool warp to scroll 0x38 (p02:85BB); ends without a boss, the ship leaves (p01:6163)
stage 4: a row of four bosses 0x0B, 0x01, 0x03, 0x04 (p01:6243) after 0xF0 frames of escorts; death restarts at the current boss
stage 9: boss 0x0D at scroll 0x1C0 while scrolling at half speed; generators run during the boss
stage 10: boss 0x0F then boss 0x11
stage 11: half-speed scroll; after boss 0x10 the scroll goes on to 0x9F, then the ending
after stage 9 the on-board computer routes by the three maps; return visits to 5/7/8 until all three are held (0xE398)
secret entrance screens (state 9) return to the same scroll; after a boss with an entrance on screen the explosion waits 0x100 frames (p05:A00D)
attract_and_menus: Konami logo (state 0) -> title (state 1, sound 0x51): a direction toggles 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS (p00:4781), fire or button 2 starts (mode 0xE302 = 0x40 or 0x60, p00:474A); any key during the logo, story or demo goes back to the title (p00:4773); the international and the Japanese BIOS build different titles (p00:5636)
idle on the title: after about 10 s the story (state 2, p30:8000, music 0x4A then 0x3E) and the demo of stages 1-3 with an invincible ship (p19:B568)

start: sound 0x43, 1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYERS blinking, HINT screen if Game Master 2 + row 1 bit 5, then the choice (state 3, p26:680C, music 0x48): ship class, SHIELD / FORCE FIELD, SHADOW / FIXED / ROLLING; the frame counter AND 3 at that moment fixes the entrance places (0xE381)
pause: F1 toggles it in a real game (p00:5B38); passwords FIND / EXPAND / GOOD / HARD + RETURN; S / L with Game Master 2
GAME OVER / CONTINUE F5 (0x1D8 frames); after the ending EXTEND PLAY / F5 (0x258 frames)
